Every non-archived product, by SKU. Cells a spreadsheet would run as a formula are
prefixed with ``'`` (import removes it again).

post.description:
Create or update products by SKU from a CSV file, all or nothing.

File-level problems are ``422`` (``csv_invalid_encoding``, ``csv_invalid_header``,
``csv_malformed``, ``csv_too_many_rows``); a body over 1 MiB is ``413``. Row problems are
returned in ``errors`` (at most 200) with ``applied: false``.

requestBody.description: The CSV file itself (UTF-8, at most 1 MiB and 2000 product rows)

get.description: Every category (inactive ones included) as a flat list with product and child counts.

post.description: Create a category. ``409 slug_taken``; ``422 category_not_found`` for an unknown parent.

delete.description:
Delete an empty category. ``409 category_not_empty`` while it has subcategories or any
products (archived ones included).

patch.description:
Change the fields sent. ``parent_id: null`` moves it to the top level; a parent that is the
category itself or one of its descendants is ``409 category_cycle``.

get.description: Orders and revenue of the current Asia/Tashkent day, and the orders waiting now.
Slots by date and start time, optionally of one zone and a date range (at most 1000).

post.description:
``cutoff_at`` may not be after the slot starts (Asia/Tashkent); ``409 slot_exists`` when
the zone already has a slot starting at that date and time.

delete.description: Only a slot with nothing booked and no order referring to it (``409 slot_in_use``).

patch.description:
Change only the fields sent. ``409 capacity_below_reserved`` below the booked places;
``409 slot_in_use`` when moving (date/times) a slot with booked places.

get.description: Every zone (inactive ones too), in display order, with its districts.

post.description: ``409 district_taken`` (with ``district``) when a district already belongs to a zone.

delete.description: Only a zone no order and no slot refers to (``409 zone_in_use``); else deactivate it.

patch.description: Change only the fields sent; ``districts`` replaces the zone's whole district set.

get.description: All orders (optionally one status), newest first.

patch.description:
Move an order one step forward, or cancel it (``reason`` required; stock is returned).

Send ``expected_status`` (the status you saw) to get ``409 order_status_conflict`` instead of
overwriting a colleague's change.

get.description: Products by ``sort_order, name_uz, id``. ``q`` matches name (uz/ru), SKU or slug.

delete.description:
Archive (soft-delete): hidden everywhere and inactive; orders keep their line snapshots.
Archiving an archived product changes nothing.

get.description: One product, archived or not.

patch.description:
Change the fields sent. ``409 product_archived`` for an archived product (restore it
first); ``old_price_uzs`` must stay above ``price_uzs`` after the change (422).

post.description: Un-archive. The product stays inactive until it is activated with ``PATCH``.

get.description: Active categories as a tree. An inactive category hides its whole subtree.

post.description:
Re-check the cart (status, current price, stock) and price delivery for a district.

Never fails because of the cart's contents: problems are reported in ``issues`` and
``can_place_order``. ``409 district_not_served`` when no active zone covers the district.
``slot_required`` and ``delivery_slots`` say whether (and which) delivery slot to book.

get.description:
Active zones with their districts, fees, minimum order and Asia/Tashkent hours.

``is_open_now`` is as of the response; it may be up to a minute stale from a cache.
Liveness: the process is up. Touches no dependency.

Readiness: the database answers ``SELECT 1`` and, when sessions and rate limits use
Redis, Redis answers ``PING``. Failures are logged by class only, never returned.

post.description:
``retry`` backs off exponentially and gives up (``failed``) after 8 attempts.

Send the ``attempts`` value from the claim as ``attempt``. 404 when the message is unknown,
already finished, its lease expired, or it was reclaimed since (a newer ``attempt``).
Upsert the user the bot is acting for. The body id must equal the signed actor.

get.description: The signed-in customer's orders, newest first.

post.description:
Place an order from the whole cart.

The same ``Idempotency-Key`` with the same body returns the original order (``200`` and
``Idempotent-Replayed: true``); with a different body it is ``409 idempotency_key_conflict``.
When the zone has delivery slots, ``delivery_slot_id`` is required (``409 slot_required``) and
booked atomically (``409 slot_full`` / ``slot_unavailable``).

parameters.description: Client-generated, unique per order attempt (a UUID). Required.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
